shared_elements: shallow relief carving of small schematic motifs on a stone surface
justification: Both surfaces carry shallow, schematic incised motifs including discs and curved bands, but that is about as generic a correspondence as carved decoration can offer. A is a flat wall filled with long horizontal registers of dense repeated sign-like glyphs, while B is a three-dimensional human figure whose few motifs (arcs, rings, a central disc, an ornamented head/back panel) are placed anatomically on a body — a fundamentally different organising scheme with no shared specific motif or relationship.
